authority: human-reading registry derived from frozen F01-F11 facts; structured data remains authoritative

figures.title_zh: 一带总览：十二条候选横断面已定位
figures.title_en: Belt Overview: Twelve Candidate Transects Located
figures.judgment_zh: 范围是约束，协同回路才是主角。
figures.judgment_en: The extent is a constraint; the collaboration loop is the main story.
figures.alt_zh: F01 三层范围、三区两翼、十二条候选责任横断面与三处重点区的关系；所有范围保持临时粗略约束状态。
figures.alt_en: F01 relationship among three scope levels, Three Areas and Two Wings, twelve candidate responsibility transects, and three key areas; every extent remains a provisional rough constraint.

figures.title_zh: 共同分区：同边界、零缺口、零重叠
figures.title_en: Shared Partition: Same Edges, Zero Gaps, Zero Overlaps
figures.judgment_zh: 完整覆盖用于复算，不代表法定用地或地块边界。
figures.judgment_en: Complete coverage supports recalculation, not statutory zoning or parcels.
figures.alt_zh: F02 四块共享边界的情景用地分区及 KEEP、OPEN、INTENSIFY 可逆动作；缺口和重叠均为零，但不是法定用地。
figures.alt_en: F02 four scenario land-use areas with shared edges and reversible KEEP, OPEN, and INTENSIFY actions; gap and overlap are zero, but the partition is not statutory zoning.

figures.title_zh: 三处重点区：同尺度看差异化在场
figures.title_en: Three Key Areas at One Comparative Scale
figures.judgment_zh: 众智园验证、AI 原点转译、大钟寺公共试用；三块边界均为 provisional。
figures.judgment_en: Zhongzhiyuan validates, AI Origin translates, and Dazhongsi hosts public trials; all three boundaries are provisional.
figures.alt_zh: F03 三处临时重点区的差异化原型与规范场景映射：SC01至SC04 众智园、SC05至SC07 AI 原点、SC09至SC11 大钟寺，SC08 与 SC12 为跨区支持。
figures.alt_en: F03 differentiated prototypes and canonical scenario mapping for three provisional key areas: SC01-SC04 Zhongzhiyuan, SC05-SC07 AI Origin, SC09-SC11 Dazhongsi, with SC08 and SC12 as cross-area supports.

figures.title_zh: 责任横断面：十二候选、三条深化
figures.title_en: Responsibility Transects: Twelve Candidates, Three Detailed
figures.judgment_zh: 十二条 CX 均未踏勘；仅 CX02、CX05、CX10 深化关系性设计目标。
figures.judgment_en: All twelve CX candidates remain unsurveyed; only CX02, CX05, and CX10 receive relational design targets.
figures.alt_zh: F04 十二条候选责任横断面及 CX02、CX05、CX10 三条关系性深化；非道路中线、工程断面或现场调查成果。
figures.alt_en: F04 twelve candidate responsibility transects and three relational details at CX02, CX05, and CX10; not road centerlines, engineering sections, or site-survey evidence.

figures.title_zh: 证据与指标：负结果也必须在场
figures.title_en: Evidence + Metrics: Adverse Results Stay Visible
figures.judgment_zh: 21 项 known、6 项 unknown；19 项可独立复算，负结果继续可见。
figures.judgment_en: Twenty-one metrics are known, six remain unknown, and nineteen are independently recomputable; adverse results stay visible.
figures.alt_zh: F05 来源、冻结哈希、指标状态与复算触发链，明确区分 known、provisional、unknown 与 design-target。
figures.alt_en: F05 source, freeze-hash, metric-status, and recalculation-trigger chain separating known, provisional, unknown, and design-target states.

figures.title_zh: 识别系统：一带、三界面、一套语法
figures.title_en: Identity System: One Belt, Three Interfaces, One Grammar
figures.judgment_zh: 共同语言服务识别、接管、验证与撤回，不冒充官方身份。
figures.judgment_en: The shared language supports recognition, takeover, verification, and withdrawal without implying official identity.
figures.alt_zh: F06 京张在场识别系统：两条轨迹、十二刻度、三个节点和开放弧线，以及三界面颜色与非颜色线型语法。
figures.alt_en: F06 Jing-Zhang In Situ identity system: two tracks, twelve ticks, three nodes, open arcs, and a color-plus-line grammar for three interfaces.

figures.title_zh: AI 创新生态：八要素内环与五域未激活接口
figures.title_en: AI Innovation Ecosystem: Internal Loop + Five Inactive Interfaces
figures.judgment_zh: 八要素通过 Gate 形成可复核内环；RI01—RI05 仅以候选 / 未授权合同停在授权边界外。
figures.judgment_en: Eight elements form a gated, auditable internal loop; RI01–RI05 remain Candidate / Not Authorized outside the authorization boundary.
figures.alt_zh: F07 三区两翼与八要素的有 Gate 内环；底部外层带列出北纬社区、未来科学城、怀柔科学城、经开区、京津冀五个空心虚线候选接口、各自首件交付物与未授权状态，全部与内环断开。
figures.alt_en: F07 gated internal loop joining Three Areas and Two Wings with eight elements; a detached lower outer band lists five hollow dashed candidate interfaces, each with its first deliverable and Not Authorized status.

figures.title_zh: 十二场景协议：AI 权限与人工接管
figures.title_en: Twelve Scenario Protocols: AI Authority + Human Takeover
figures.judgment_zh: 每一场景都直接说明 AI 只可做什么、什么必须由人决定、如何接管、低技术替代与退出。
figures.judgment_en: Every scenario states what AI may do, what humans alone decide, how takeover works, the low-tech fallback, and the exit path.
figures.alt_zh: F08 十二场景的 AI 权限、人工唯一决定、Human Takeover 前台动作、低技术替代与运行到撤场归档状态矩阵；SC01、SC05、SC10 为旗舰。
figures.alt_en: F08 matrix of AI authority, human-only decisions, visible Human Takeover, low-tech fallback, and operating-to-removal/archive states for twelve scenarios; SC01, SC05, and SC10 are flagships.

figures.title_zh: 三处地标、开放贡献谱与公共空间组件库
figures.title_en: Three Landmarks + Open Contribution Ledger + Components
figures.judgment_zh: 贡献可复核、可纠错、可撤回；概念组件可逆、可维护、可退出。
figures.judgment_en: Contributions are reviewable, correctable, and withdrawable; conceptual components remain reversible, maintainable, and removable.
figures.alt_zh: F09 三处概念地标、开放贡献谱与 C01 至 C09 公共空间组件库，均带复核、纠错和撤回边界。
figures.alt_en: F09 three conceptual landmarks, an open contribution ledger, and public-space components C01-C09, each with review, correction, and withdrawal boundaries.

figures.title_zh: 文化叙事与导视：时间成为空间坐标
figures.title_en: Culture + Wayfinding: Time as a Spatial Coordinate
figures.judgment_zh: 京张铁路、中关村创新与 AI 透明治理并置而不混同。
figures.judgment_en: Jing-Zhang rail memory, Zhongguancun innovation, and transparent AI remain distinct.
figures.alt_zh: F10 京张铁路记忆、中关村创新和 AI 透明文化三条时间线及六级导视体系。
figures.alt_en: F10 three time strands for Jing-Zhang railway memory, Zhongguancun innovation, and transparent AI, plus the six-level wayfinding system.

figures.title_zh: 运行、接管、申诉、停止与撤场
figures.title_en: Operate, Take Over, Appeal, Stop, and Remove
figures.judgment_zh: 9 状态、15 转换与唯一 SC10＋IM06 首用仍约束退出；区域接口准备度仅为 5 合同 / 0 授权 / 0 运行。
figures.judgment_en: Nine states, fifteen transitions, and the sole SC10+IM06 first use still constrain exit; regional-interface readiness is only 5 contracts / 0 authorized / 0 operating.
figures.alt_zh: F11 运行、Human Takeover、投诉申诉、暂停停止、撤场归档的完整路径；含唯一首用预检、保留的不通过停止或 unknown 结果，以及与生命周期分隔的区域接口 5 合同、0 授权、0 运行小型状态块。
figures.alt_en: F11 complete path for operation, Human Takeover, complaint and appeal, pause and stop, removal and archive; includes the sole first-use preflight, retained fail, stop, or unknown outcomes, and a lifecycle-separated mini status block showing five regional-interface contracts, zero authorized, and zero operating.
